verdict.rationale: ADK's own README documents a Tool Confirmation (HITL) flow that guards tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input, which is a first-party capability for human approval before tool calls run. Evidence is limited to brief README feature lines, so per-tool targeting of specific sensitive calls and the approval mechanics are not shown. Workflow and Task API human-in-the-loop mentions are adjacent context, not tool-call gating. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing configuration of which specific tools require approval, details of the approval/resume flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can require human approval before specific sensitive tool calls execute
